[Why we exist]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">A healthy ocean depends on people.</h2>

<div class="section__lead">
The Upwelling Project invests directly in emerging ocean leaders through
recognised qualifications, practical experience and a community that helps
them take the next step.

Our work begins with scientific and professional diving. Over time, we aim to
support research, community and development programs across our region.
</div>

[Our direction]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">Skills, pathways and people</h2>

::: {.cards}
::: {.card}
<div class="card__number">01</div>

### Vision

To develop ocean leaders with the skills, experience and pathways to build
meaningful marine careers.
:::

::: {.card}
<div class="card__number">02</div>

### Mission

We open pathways to practical training, recognised qualifications, field
experience and the networks that help launch marine careers.
:::

::: {.card}
<div class="card__number">03</div>

### Our approach

Each award provides funding directly to the recipient — for a recognised
qualification and a placement or field experience they choose — so they can
shape their own pathway with a suitable plan at the time of selection.
:::
:::
:::

[Who we are]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">From the Australasian arm of OWUSS</h2>
:::

::: {}
<div class="section__lead">
The Upwelling Project grows out of the [Our World-Underwater Scholarship
Society](https://www.owuscholarship.org/) Australasian arm — a volunteer-run
program that has fostered emerging leaders in the underwater world since 1974.

For decades, Australasian scholars documented their journeys on
[OWUSS Australasia](https://owussaustralasia.org/), sharing training, field
work and career pathways with the community. Some of those alumni are now
helping shape The Upwelling Project as we write a new chapter for the region:
direct funding, recipient-led plans, and a continued commitment to practical
pathways into marine work.

We remain connected to the wider OWUSS community, which continues its work
internationally.
</div>
